USA|maize|main.summary: U.S. maize uses one pooled ENSO sensitivity across all 2,733 mapped counties in this release. Differences in shading come from growing-season calendars and ENSO exposure; county boundaries do not indicate separate county fits.
USA|maize|main.explanation: We first estimated 41 state responses, then pooled them according to their uncertainty. The estimated between-state variance was zero, so the pooling model assigned every state the same coefficient (about +3.5% yield per +1 °C of growing-season relative Niño 3.4). This does not establish that the true responses are identical. Eleven calendar windows produce the eleven displayed yield-change values.
